appearances.snippet: It reads, letter bombs mailed to Truman. And it tells us that the so-called stern gang of the Zionist terrorists tried to assassinate President Truman by letter bomb in 1947, according to a new biography written by Mr.

verification.notes: The cited New York Times article exists under the headline Letter-Bombs Mailed to Truman in 1947 and reported Margaret Truman's biography as saying Stern Gang letter bombs were sent to the White House to kill President Truman. Contemporary reporting independently documents the Stern Gang's 1947 letter-bomb campaign, though the White House attribution chiefly derives from the biography and mail-room account.
